ticket.title: Dispensing modal: "Dispense all prescriptions" fires before medication request data has loaded
ticket.text:
Dispensing modal: "Dispense all prescriptions" fires before medication request data has loaded

## Summary

The On Prescription Filled modal (`src/fill-prescription/on-prescription-filled.modal.tsx`) renders as soon as the order basket is signed, but the medication request bundles are fetched asynchronously via `usePrescriptionDetails` (SWR). While that fetch is in-flight, `medicationRequestBundles` is an empty array.

If the user (or an automated test) clicks Dispense all prescriptions before the fetch resolves, `onConfirm()` iterates over an empty array and makes no dispense or fulfiller-status requests. `close()` is still called, so the modal dismisses silently and the prescriptions are never marked as dispensed.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Open the dispensing app and start a paper prescription.
2. Fill and sign the order.
3. In the Dispense prescriptions modal, click Dispense all prescriptions immediately (within ~1–2 s of the modal appearing).
4. Observe: no `MedicationDispense` or `MedicationRequest` PATCH requests are sent; the prescription remains Active.

## Root cause

`usePrescriptionDetails` returns `medicationRequestBundles: []` until the SWR fetch completes. The confirm button has no guard against this loading state.

## Fix

Disable the Dispense all prescriptions button while `isLoading` from `usePrescriptionDetails` is `true`:

```tsx
const { medicationRequestBundles, isLoading: isLoadingPrescriptionDetails } = usePrescriptionDetails(encounterUuid);
// ...
<Button disabled={isSubmitting || isLoadingPrescriptionDetails} onClick={() => onConfirm()}>
  {t('dispenseAllPrescriptions', 'Dispense all prescriptions')}
</Button>
```

This also resolves intermittent e2e test failures where Playwright clicks the button before the data arrives.

criteria.text: The "Dispense all prescriptions" button becomes enabled once prescription details have finished loading (provided the form is not submitting).
Clicking "Dispense all prescriptions" after data loads triggers the dispense requests and marks the prescriptions as dispensed.
